entry.title: How could AI best help Alzheimer's patients now and in the future?
entry.content: Alzheimer's is a terrible thing to go through. I was thinking about how we can help Alzheimer's from the care side rather than the disease and cure side. entry.content: We talk about the OpenAI–Hugging Face incident, where an OpenAI model — in the middle of a cyber evaluation — broke out of its sandbox and autonomously hacked Hugging Face. We discuss: What we actually know happened. How surprising the incident was. What the incident does (and doesn’t) tell us about misalignment risk. Why control measures didn’t catch or prevent this.
